description.zh: 权限过期时间，UTC时间格式。（仅fullaccess权限需要设置）
description.en: Permission expiration time in UTC format. (Required only for fullAccess permission.)

description.zh: 账号名称，支持多个账号，用逗号分隔
description.en: Account name. Multiple accounts are supported and must be separated by commas.

descriptions.zh:
## 请求说明
- 在使用此接口前，请确保已在 DAS 安全中心 开通列加密服务。
- 如果在调用接口时收到错误信息ColumnEncryptionErrorCode.NOT_PURCHASED，请前往 DAS（数据库自治服务）安全中心 购买并开通列加密服务后再使用。
descriptions.en:
## Request Description
- Before using this API, ensure that you have enabled the column encryption service in DAS Security Center.
- If you receive the error message ColumnEncryptionErrorCode.NOT_PURCHASED when invoking the API, go to the DAS (Database Autonomy Service) Security Center to purchase and enable the column encryption service before using it again.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds modify-account-masking-privilege --user-name user1,user2 --expire-time 2026-01-22T02:01:20Z --privilege restrictedAccess --db-instance-name rm-t4n8t18o0000006d5 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-name myDB --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun rds ModifyAccountMaskingPrivilege --region cn-hangzhou --UserName 'user1,user2' --DBName myDB --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ExpireTime '2026-01-22T02:01:20Z' --Privilege restrictedAccess --DBInstanceName 'rm-t4n8t18o0000006d5'
